summary: Stackable banquet chairs are the hotel ballroom standard: about 17 in wide, 22 in deep, 36.75 in tall, seat about 19 in, padded fabric or vinyl on a silver or black frame. Wooden farm benches about 96 by 14 in seat 4 to 5 adults and suit rustic ceremonies and family-style tables.
